description: Utility functions for handling purchase-related operations in ERPNext, including updating last purchase rates, validating items, checking document status, and retrieving linked material requests.

methods.name: update_last_purchase_rate
methods.description: Updates the last purchase rate for each item in a document based on purchase history and current transaction.

methods.name: validate_for_items
methods.description: Validates item quantities, stock status, end-of-life, and duplicate entries in a purchase document.

methods.name: check_on_hold_or_closed_status
methods.description: Checks if a document's status is 'Closed' or 'On Hold' and raises an error if so.

methods.name: get_linked_material_requests
methods.description: Retrieves linked material requests for given items, filtering by purchase request status and other criteria.
